description: Sanitizes the inline HTML allowed inside text-bearing blocks: only a small safe whitelist of tags and attributes survives; scripts/styles are dropped with their content, event handlers and unsafe URL schemes are stripped. The link allow-list is UrlSchemePolicy (the same http/https/mailto/tel + relative rules the render pipeline applies, D22). Built on AngleSharp's HTML parser so it is robust against evasion.

members.name: Sanitize
members.description: Returns a sanitized copy of html safe to embed in generated markup.
